status_label: DRAFT / OPEN / Ring 4 / NOT LICENSED / HELD
review_rule: Accept only the source-bounded wording and preserve every prohibited inference. A review disposition does not promote admission ring, license, disclosure, canon, product, empirical, causal, physical, safety, clinical, or regulatory status.

entries.statement: The CAS PCBA v8 Python candidate represents components, ports, signal kinds, units, parameters, nets, state literals, test points, calibration references, and feedback declarations with closed typed contracts.
entries.finding: The bound types, contracts, model, and DRC tests support the narrow implementation statement.
entries.required_action: Preserve candidate and bounded-software qualifiers.
entries.boundary_preserved: No CCDL completeness, cognitive validity, physical identity, or product-readiness inference.

entries.statement: Complete declared board structure participates in an immutable canonical identity, and exact runtime value tags distinguish Boolean true, integer 1, and string true.
entries.finding: Canonical identity and exact-type collision defenses are tested in the bound candidate.
entries.required_action: Retain exact-version and candidate scope.
entries.boundary_preserved: No cryptographic authenticity, semantic equivalence, or tamper-proofing inference.

entries.statement: The deterministic DRC checks declared component contracts, typed connectivity, driver count, required ports, signal/unit compatibility, calibration linkage, and test-point requirements and fails boards carrying errors.
entries.finding: The implemented checks and fail-on-error behavior are covered by the bound suite.
entries.required_action: Do not generalize beyond the supported profile and declared checks.
entries.boundary_preserved: No completeness, soundness for every circuit, or safety certification inference.

entries.statement: The DRC uses graph-cycle analysis and conservative per-cycle gain checks for declared feedback in the supported profile.
entries.finding: Cycle enumeration and conservative declared-gain checks are implemented and tested.
entries.required_action: Keep supported-profile and conservative qualifiers.
entries.boundary_preserved: No stability result for stateful, delayed, stochastic, adaptive, nonlinear, or unmodeled feedback.

entries.statement: For supported activation paths, the DRC reports an unreachable threshold when the derived upstream upper bound is below the declared fuse threshold.
entries.finding: The known-fault fixture confirms the 0.1 upstream clamp cannot cross the 0.9 fuse threshold.
entries.required_action: Preserve the known-fault finding and do not imply the source board is repaired.
entries.boundary_preserved: Non-finite gain and incomplete latch/fail-closed semantics remain unresolved.

entries.statement: The narrow reference simulator emits deterministic trace and measurement records bound to board, DRC, catalog, decimal-context, source, calibration, and child-lineage identities.
entries.finding: Deterministic record and identity binding are supported by the bounded implementation and tests.
entries.required_action: Retain narrow reference-simulator wording.
entries.boundary_preserved: No operational validity, real-time behavior, physical measurement, or general simulation claim.

entries.statement: Only certified total finite deterministic stateless non-stochastic transition tables can cross the candidate TKS v8 adapter, and the certificate binds the exact kernel and PCBA identities.
entries.finding: The adapter rejects the audited out-of-profile transition forms and binds exact identities.
entries.required_action: Keep every finite, total, deterministic, stateless, and non-stochastic restriction.
entries.boundary_preserved: No general TKS equivalence, stateful dynamics, cognition, or canon migration.

entries.statement: The candidate keeps the mixed-simplex Fisher-Rao profile and optional projector profile type-distinct and binds projector matrix, rank, source/basis, tolerance, and validation residuals.
entries.finding: The optional projector representation is type-distinct from the canonical simplex representation.
entries.required_action: Reference Formal Mathematics Paper 3 for theorem content; do not treat type implementation as theorem satisfaction.
entries.boundary_preserved: No state-capacity certificate, equivalence, or replacement of the canonical simplex baseline.

entries.statement: The consolidated formal CCDL EBNF does not cover the published five-board reference corpus; four boards contain direct syntax counterexamples and one bounded listing has no direct counterexample established by this audit.
entries.finding: Gate 4 reconfirmed four direct grammar counterexamples across the five-board corpus.
entries.required_action: Keep the fifth-board wording exact; absence of a found counterexample is not proof of conformance.
entries.boundary_preserved: No complete grammar, parser, round trip, or corpus-conformance claim.

entries.statement: Under the published clamp semantics, the CSB red stage capped at 0.1 cannot cross its downstream 0.9 fuse threshold; the same source also uses non-finite gain without complete latch/fail-closed semantics.
entries.finding: The arithmetic contradiction and associated source limitations are directly reproducible.
entries.required_action: Retain as a quarantined source finding until a versioned replacement and migration decision exist.
entries.boundary_preserved: No implication that the board is operationally valid or repaired.

entries.statement: A complete versioned CCDL grammar, parser, canonical round trip, and corpus conformance package do not exist in the admitted candidate.
entries.finding: No inspected artifact closes this obligation.
entries.required_action: Remain open pending versioned grammar, parser, round-trip tests, ambiguity tests, corpus conformance, and independent replay.
entries.boundary_preserved: No syntax-completeness or language-conformance claim.

entries.statement: Capacitor, PLL, memory, power, richer feedback, stochastic, and memristive time/state semantics remain unspecified or unvalidated.
entries.finding: The bound implementation remains deliberately narrow and lacks these semantics.
entries.required_action: Keep all listed dynamics open until separately specified, implemented, and validated.
entries.boundary_preserved: No stateful, stochastic, adaptive, memory, power, or memristive behavior claim.

entries.statement: No live PCBA calibration, authenticated instrumentation, environmental validity, uncertainty/drift validation, or held-out external result is admitted.
entries.finding: The package contains bounded software receipts, not live or external validation.
entries.required_action: Remain open pending authenticated, independently reviewed external evidence.
entries.boundary_preserved: No live measurement, environmental validity, calibration, drift, or replication claim.

entries.statement: PCBA safety effectiveness, certification, regulatory compliance, and clinical suitability are not established.
entries.finding: No inspected artifact supplies the required qualified evidence or authority.
entries.required_action: Preserve not-licensed status and require domain-qualified independent review before any change.
entries.boundary_preserved: No safety, clinical, certification, or regulatory claim.

entries.statement: The CAS-Ohm candidate keeps quantity kind, exact decimal, unit, measurement kind, method, calibration profile, uncertainty, sample size, lineage, raw evidence, controls, and missingness type-distinct.
entries.finding: The type distinction is supported, but the paper incorrectly implies that physical SI quantities are members of the current UnitKind ontology.
entries.required_action: Apply S-ENG-002: state that physical SI quantities are outside the current ontology and require a separately typed physical profile.
entries.boundary_preserved: No metrological traceability, physical telemetry, or empirical validity inference.

entries.statement: Calibration profiles bind the declared model, direction, corpus, splits, methods, tolerances, controls, validity interval, drift, and digest; calibrated held-out resistance is distinguished from same-sample apparent resistance.
entries.finding: The type and validation controls are implemented; same-sample circularity is explicitly excluded.
entries.required_action: Preserve split separation, direction, profile, provenance, and validity requirements.
entries.boundary_preserved: No evidence that a profile has been empirically calibrated or externally validated.

entries.statement: Dose-response region and semantic outcome are independent classifications in the candidate.
entries.finding: The two classifications are represented independently in the bound candidate.
entries.required_action: Keep the classifications separate in prose and interfaces.
entries.boundary_preserved: No claim that either classification is empirically valid or causally meaningful.

entries.statement: Q4 bands use exact unrounded values and half-open boundaries at 2.5, 5, and 7.5.
entries.finding: Boundary behavior is correct, but the exact pre-clipping classifier can receive values above 10 while the paper shows Q4 ending at 10.
entries.required_action: Apply S-ENG-001: define Q4 as [7.5, infinity) for exact input, or explicitly label [7.5, 10] as the clipped display interval.
entries.boundary_preserved: No validation of the full-scale method or semantic interpretation.

entries.statement: Series, parallel, and gain-product calculations are profile-, unit-, coordinate-, topology-, region-, child-, and provenance-gated structural research operations.
entries.finding: The implementation enforces the declared structural guards.
entries.required_action: Retain structural-only, local-region, covariance, topology, and provenance qualifications.
entries.boundary_preserved: No physical circuit law, causal composition, global behavior, or empirical prediction.

entries.statement: Residual diagnosis is restricted to matching active, reviewed, nonstale, held-out instrumented evidence with uncertainty and remains explicitly non-identifying.
entries.finding: Structural guards and non-identification are preserved, but nonstale is evaluated only relative to caller-supplied replay time.
entries.required_action: Apply S-ENG-003: say replay-time-current, not authenticated-current.
entries.boundary_preserved: No live freshness, causal diagnosis, hidden-cause identification, or validated localization.

entries.statement: Structural research-packet completeness and authenticated Evidence Packet eligibility are separate, and authenticated eligibility is false in the current candidate.
entries.finding: The candidate explicitly separates structural completeness from authority and always denies authenticated-current eligibility.
entries.required_action: Preserve the false authenticated-eligibility result until an admitted authority path exists.
entries.boundary_preserved: No signature, trusted timestamp, WORM receipt, identity, authorization, or product acceptance.

entries.statement: The three CAS-Ohm sources retain eight conflicts or under-specifications across scale/saturation, full-scale method, dimensional bridge, gain, ASOM, network rules, residual identification, and Q4 boundaries.
entries.finding: All eight recorded conflicts were present and were reconfirmed by Gate 4.
entries.required_action: Keep the conflicts quarantined; do not silently select a source interpretation as canonical.
entries.boundary_preserved: No claim that the candidate resolves historical source conflicts or has canon authority.

entries.statement: For common finite-rank orthogonal projectors in one Hilbert space, normalized Hilbert-Schmidt overlap is a positive-semidefinite kernel in [0,1].
entries.finding: The engineering summary omits d > 0; at common rank zero the normalized expression is 0/0 and undefined.
entries.required_action: Resolve B-ENG-001 by adding common rank d > 0, and B-ENG-002 by binding Formal Mathematics Paper 3 as sole theorem authority.
entries.boundary_preserved: No strict positive-definiteness, capacity result, empirical meaning, or CAS realization.

entries.statement: A proposed CAS projector-capacity specialization would require a CAS-specific representation satisfying every source hypothesis, including the omitted isometry/intertwining identity.
entries.finding: The open status is correct; Formal Mathematics Paper 3 supplies the governing hypotheses and counterexample, but the engineering package lacks its exact cross-lane binding.
entries.required_action: Resolve B-ENG-002; keep the theorem a proof gap until a CAS-specific isometry and adjoint-intertwining certificate are verified.
entries.boundary_preserved: No CAS capacity bound, implementation certificate, or empirical result.

entries.statement: CAS-Ohm design scores, proxies, and model-derived quantities are physical electrical telemetry or validated measurements.
entries.finding: The current type, source, and evidence boundaries contradict this affirmative claim.
entries.required_action: Keep the claim explicitly contradicted and not licensed.
entries.boundary_preserved: No physical voltage, current, resistance, charge, flux, power, device, material, or telemetry interpretation.

entries.statement: Within one frozen active-region profile, activation projection varies predictably with randomized steering alpha on held-out prompts.
entries.finding: No preregistration, qualified Evidence Packet, randomized held-out result, or independent review is present.
entries.required_action: Remain open pending the declared experiment and review obligations.
entries.boundary_preserved: No empirical dose-response or causal effect claim.

entries.statement: A calibration-split effective-resistance parameter predicts held-out response and changes as predicted under an independently characterized non-safety constraint manipulation.
entries.finding: The software distinguishes calibrated and apparent quantities, but no held-out predictive experiment exists.
entries.required_action: Remain open; prohibit same-sample apparent resistance from predictive evidence.
entries.boundary_preserved: No calibrated prediction, causal manipulation, physical resistance, or safety claim.

entries.finding: Only guarded structural calculations are implemented; the empirical composition claim is untested.
entries.required_action: Remain open pending independent calibration, coordinate checks, held-out tests, uncertainty treatment, and review.
entries.boundary_preserved: No global gain law, physical amplification, causal composition, or empirical validation.

entries.statement: Ablating a genuine redundant non-safety branch increases required steering alpha more than matched random-head ablation.
entries.finding: No matched-control ablation result or Evidence Packet is present.
entries.required_action: Remain open pending preregistered, non-safety matched-control evidence and independent review.
entries.boundary_preserved: No redundancy, causal, model-behavior, or safety-effectiveness claim.

entries.source_status: OPEN / NOT PREREGISTERED / NO EVIDENCE PACKET / NOT LICENSED
entries.statement: A calibrated residual diagnostic localizes blinded implanted non-safety faults above shuffled and matched-control baselines without identifying hidden causes from residual sign.
entries.finding: The implementation enforces non-identifying structural guards; no blinded localization experiment is admitted.
entries.required_action: Remain open and preserve the explicit ban on identifying causes from residual sign.
entries.boundary_preserved: No causal diagnosis, hidden-cause identification, safety finding, or validated localization.

entries.statement: A future CAS response profile may require an explicit history state and could be compared with a matched memoryless profile.
entries.finding: No memristive implementation terms, calibrated history state, hysteresis result, device, or physical mapping exist in the bound source and tests.
entries.required_action: Remain open until an explicit nonphysical state model, preregistered comparison, evidence, and independent review exist.
entries.boundary_preserved: No physical memristor, charge/flux mapping, material device, learned resistance, or validated hysteresis.

closure_statement: The review permits no claim widening. All experimental, causal, physical, material, stateful, memristive, safety, clinical, regulatory, product, canon, license, disclosure, authorship, cross-review, and external-review conclusions remain OPEN unless explicitly negative or NOT LICENSED.
